main.description: A named rendering of the account holder's CV: which sections, in what order, drawn from which collections, filtered and sorted how. Researchers do not have one CV -- they keep a fellowship version, a faculty-application version, an industry resume, a Japanese 業績票, and a two-line bio, all from the same underlying facts. Making the VIEW a record rather than baking one layout into the app means all of them regenerate from one record set. Because `sectionSpec.source` is an NSID string, a dossier can pull employment history from id.sifa.profile.position alongside sections from this namespace.

locale.description: BCP-47 tag for headings, date formatting, and name ordering. The single field that makes a bilingual CV possible from one record set.

cslStyle.description: CSL style for rendering the publication sections, e.g. 'apa', 'ieee'.

includeUnlisted.description: Whether to include records whose `disclosure` is 'unlisted'. Useful for a private full CV rendered locally.

highlightSelf.description: Bold or underline the profile owner's name in author lists, expected by most application formats.

headerNote.description: Free text placed above the first section, e.g. a research statement summary.

templateUrl.description: Optional LaTeX or Typst template the renderer should use.

isDefault.description: Which dossier a public profile page renders. At most one should be true; consumers seeing several should pick the most recently updated.
